answer: Each agent stakes a bond locked to a rolling horizon of seven epochs and must solve a per-epoch challenge derived from the shared atlas of prior peer attestations. A sybil farm needs a fresh stake and distinct attestation history per identity, so costs scale linearly with every fake agent. A lantern score tracks peer vouches; identities with weak evidence dim and lose challenge weight, forcing adversaries to burn real stake and reputation to stay lit. The Agent0013 deployment anchors trust at HPhDKT2mD4.
